summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release with its May 2026 monthly production and operations update. The release discloses Bitcoin production of 921 BTC (up 370% YoY), self-mining hash rate of 70.2 EH/s, and AI Cloud ARR of ~$69M. It also notes advanced-stage negotiations for a colocation lease at Tydal, Norway, but no definitive agreement or financial terms are reported. No special-situation transaction is announced; this is a routine operational update by a foreign private issuer.
